headline: Gujarat Raffia submits AGM scrutinizer report
hook: Routine paperwork filed for annual poll
summary: Gujarat Raffia Industries Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report for its annual general meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchange. This is a routine compliance filing documenting the voting results of shareholder resolutions. The submission completes the mandatory post-AGM regulatory process for the company. For an Indian retail investor, this procedural filing carries no immediate financial or operational impact.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for retail investors from routine compliance filings.
